events.title: Evergy to Post Q1 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock This Season?
events.body: EVRG heads into its Q1 results with EPS seen up 17%, as data-center load and grid modernization investments stay in focus.

events.title: All Eyes on Vistra's Q1 Earnings: What Lies Ahead for the Stock?
events.body: VST heads into Q1 report with revenues seen up 37% and EPS up 380%, as data-center power demand and buybacks take center stage.

events.title: Eversource Energy to Release Q1 Earnings: What's in the Cards?
events.body: ES' heads into first-quarter earnings results with smart meter installs, transmission investments and disciplined costs in focus, though higher interest expenses may have affected gains.

events.title: NiSource to Report Q1 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
events.body: NI heads into Q1 earnings with rising data center demand, customer growth and new rates expected to lift revenues and profits.
